description: 272 Palestinian patients at Al-Shifa Hospital assessed with DASS-21 and pain catastrophising scales. Half were unemployed, 94.1% lived on under 1,974 ILS a month, and median pain duration was four years.
energy_note: Four years of pain, on under two thousand shekels a month.

description: Depression 83.1%, anxiety 83.8%, stress 88.6% - with pain catastrophising correlating strongly with psychological distress.
energy_note: Nearly nine in ten, on every measure.

aspect: The authors' recommendation is the one thing unavailable
description: They call for integrated, trauma-informed pain management addressing biomedical and psychosocial factors together - in a health system with 17 of 36 hospitals functioning.
energy_note: The right treatment, and nowhere to deliver it.

aspect: Pain of this duration reshapes a life, not a week
description: Four years median duration means work capacity, sleep, mood, parenting and relationships have all already reorganised around it before anyone measured anything.
energy_note: Long enough that it's just who you are now.
